record_type_quote:
Our study was conducted with intact high school and vocational school classes
in Italy and Bosnia.

targets.title: Effects of form-focused practice and feedback on Chinese EFL learners’ acquisition of regular and irregular past tense forms.
targets.evidence_quote: This study set out to replicate YL (2010) with a population of adolescents.
targets.outcome_quote:
The ﬁndings from our study did not fully
align with Yang and Lyster’s results. We found no effect of group and no evidence of the
superiority of either prompts or recasts in either written or oral data in either Bosnia or
Italy. However, we found a steady increase in scores over time from pretest to posttests
in oral data in all groups at both sites.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors report incomplete alignment overall. No group superiority contrasts with the original prompt advantage, whereas differential recast effects on irregular verbs in oral data agree with the original (Table 13, RQ2a); the paper also explicitly notes agreement in control-group improvement. Thus partly agreeing and partly differing findings across both sites, not a completely confirmed result.

reasoning: Completed multisite registered report using new adolescent samples retests Yang and Lyster (2010). The 2008 dissertation is a separate citation for scoring and is not an additional target. Multiple sites remain one target paper.
